title: Kissed with Smoky Flaky Kenyan Sweet Potatoes Hash
description: A flavorful and flaky vegetarian hash dish featuring smoky sweet potatoes, blackcurrant jam, and a hint of floral notes.

ingredients.name: 1 tsp smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: smoked paprika adds a deep smoky flavor

instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes, placing them in a large bowl.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the sweet potatoes and toss to coat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the bowl with the sweet potatoes.
In a small bowl, mix together the blackcurrant jam, ground ginger, and smoked paprika.
Pour the jam mixture over the sweet potatoes and toss to coat.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
While the sweet potatoes are baking, heat a molcajete over medium heat.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Add the cooked sweet potatoes to the molcajete and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, breaking them up with a spatula as they cook.
Serve the sweet potato hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
